name: camera/camera-shake
title: Camera Shake
title_vi: Rung máy cầm tay / ống tele / giàn máy
desc_vi: Rung máy quay theo 9 kiểu đo thật (cầm tay, tele, giàn máy) cho bất kỳ khối bọc nào, tính theo thời gian nên tua chính xác.
params_vi: shakeProfile: Shake profile (handheld-normal-mild | handheld-normal-strong | handheld-normal-extreme | handheld-wideangle-mild | handheld-wideangle-strong | handheld-tele-mild | handheld-tele-strong | rig-6d-shake | rig-6d-wobble), mặc định "handheld-normal-mild" · shakeIntensity: Intensity multiplier, mặc định 1 · shakeFrequency: Frequency multiplier, mặc định 1 · shakeRotation: Include rotation (roll + tilt/pan), mặc định true · duration: độ dài của block (6 s) · replace: các cặp [chữ gốc, chữ mới] đổi nội dung trước khi chạy (ví dụ tiếng Việt)
notes: Run as shipped: the block's own page (assets/demo.html) in an iframe, its timeline set from the film's time. Fonts: Google / fontsource families are drawn with the kit's RFlex / RMono. Shown through the component's own demo page (a full composition). To apply the snippet to the film's own elements, ask Claude: the snippet is in assets/camera-shake.html. Source: Procedural handheld, telephoto and rig camera shake for any wrapper: nine measured profiles with per-lens projection, closed-form and seek-safe
